name: Nisshi
description: Nisshi (formerly Tansu) is a stateless, Apache Kafka compatible broker with pluggable storage. This script installs the single binary with the embedded SQLite storage engine.

notes.text: There is no web interface. Kafka clients connect to the container on port 9092.

The broker advertises the container IP it had during the install. If that IP changes, update ADVERTISED_LISTENER_URL in /opt/nisshi_data/.env and run systemctl restart nisshi, otherwise clients cannot connect.
No authentication or TLS is configured: anyone who can reach port 9092 can read and write topics.
All data is in /opt/nisshi_data/nisshi.db. Updates replace /opt/nisshi and leave /opt/nisshi_data untouched.

Nisshi can also store its data in S3 or PostgreSQL, write topics to an Apache Iceberg lakehouse and export OpenTelemetry metrics. None of that is set up by this script - see the documentation and configure it in /opt/nisshi_data/.env, then run systemctl restart nisshi.
